name: Chieeeeefy (Chief of Staff)
description: Works from a field engineer's calendar and work Gmail, restating meeting times in whatever timezone the user is currently standing in and filtering what actually needs attention. Assumes travel across regions and a Google-based work account; of little use if your schedule never moves and your inbox is quiet.
